title: Grading Standard for Devices Taken in Under Northbeam Renew Trade-In
content:
The refurbishment bench grades every device taken in under Northbeam Renew Trade-In against the condition ladder of the programme the agreement was written under. A grade is a share of the quoted amount, and the shares differ from programme to programme.

Share of the quoted amount at each condition:

| Condition found | Renew Instant Store Quote | Renew Mail In Appraisal | Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twelve Month | Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twenty Four Month | Renew Business Asset Buyback | Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| like new | 100 per cent | 100 per cent | 100 per cent | 100 per cent | 100 per cent | 100 per cent |
| good | 85 per cent | 88 per cent | 92 per cent | 95 per cent | 90 per cent | 93 per cent |
| fair | 60 per cent | 65 per cent | 75 per cent | 80 per cent | 70 per cent | 72 per cent |
| poor | 30 per cent | 35 per cent | 45 per cent | 50 per cent | 40 per cent | 42 per cent |
| broken | 10 per cent | 12 per cent | 15 per cent | 18 per cent | 20 per cent | 22 per cent |
| not as declared | 0 per cent | 0 per cent | 0 per cent | 0 per cent | 0 per cent | 0 per cent |

What the top of each ladder means on each programme: on Renew Instant Store Quote, screen and body unmarked, powers on, no lock; on Renew Mail In Appraisal, screen and body unmarked, powers on, no lock, charger present; on both Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twelve Month and Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twenty Four Month, screen and body unmarked, powers on, no lock, bought with the guarantee; on Renew Business Asset Buyback, asset tag present, powers on, enterprise lock cleared; on Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement, asset tag present, powers on, enterprise lock cleared, in a palletised batch.

Deductions the bench may find, as a percentage, and whether the programme takes a locked device or one showing liquid ingress at all:

| Renew programme | Cracked screen or panel | Will not power on | Charger or stylus missing | Locked device taken | Deduction where a locked device is taken | Device showing liquid ingress taken |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Renew Instant Store Quote | 50 | 80 | 10 | no | 0 | no |
| Renew Mail In Appraisal | 45 | 75 | 8 | no | 0 | no |
| Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twelve Month | 35 | 60 | 5 | no | 0 | no |
| Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twenty Four Month | 30 | 55 | 5 | no | 0 | no |
| Renew Business Asset Buyback | 40 | 70 | 0 | yes | 40 | yes |
| Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement | 40 | 65 | 0 | yes | 50 | yes |

Points of judgement on the tables.

- A condition column is the share of the quoted amount that condition carries, not an amount in USD; the amount follows from the quote on the agreement.
- Where a programme does not take a locked device at all, the locked deduction column stands at 0 because no locked device is taken on that programme for a deduction to be worked on.
- The two business programmes are the only Renew programmes that take a device showing liquid ingress.
